notes.title: Update Notes 7/18/2024
notes.content:
Hello Gigantic fans!

We’ve just deployed our major patch for July that we had promised you in our last Dev Update. This patch fixes match grades, makes improvements to Easy Anti Cheat, and includes a ton of additional fixes and balancing changes. As always, you can read the full patch notes further below!

Reminder that Season One begins on July 23 across all platforms. We’re very excited for Ranked to officially kick-off and have in-game reward events planned for you to have the chance to get brand-new content that wasn’t in the original Gigantic, like new hero skins and weapon skins for some of your favorite heroes. 

[h3]--Fixes in Today’s Patch--[/h3]

Build number: #614761.0

[b]General[/b]
- Fixed summoning bug on Ember Grove point A during clash
- Reduced frequency of players being placed on the wrong regional servers
- Fixed players often not getting penalty points for dodging or leaving ranked matches
- Improvements made to Easy Anti Cheat
- Fixed the match grade calculations
- Changed Mozu's “Flee before me!” fortune tier 3 so it's more reasonable to complete
- Fixed Pakko's “Covered in Snow” fortune not always progressing
 
[b]Balance Changes[/b]
[u]Kajir[/u]
- RMB: Reduced charge 2 damage 350 > 300
- RMB-Finesse: Reduced charge 3 damage 450 > 400
- Q: Decreased cooldown 18 > 15s
- Q: Removed the 200 base damage
- Q: Reduced damage against enemies above 75% hp, 200 > 180
- Q Trick up the Sleeve: Changed to deal bonus damage when hitting an enemy from behind (+180)
- Q Prowl: Changed to start RMB at charge level 2 after using Q
[u]Aisling[/u]
- LMB-Spectral defense: Reduced armor buff 20 > 10
- RMB-Cador's Restoration: Cador heals allies for 35 > 30 hp/s
- Q-Talent: Heals Cador for 750 > 500
- E: Cooldown range: 8-14 > 8-16s
- When Cador dies: Cooldown of all skills 15s > 18s
[u]Uncle Sven[/u]
- Q: Removed push against enemies
- Q-Sticks to You: Adds push against enemies
- Q-Bounces off me: Reduced armor buff 20 > 10
- Q-Super Bounce: Now increases the armor buff to +20 armor
- Q-Absorption Matrix: Reduced the healing duration 10s > 5s
- E-Persistent Purgative: Immunity now only applies while inside the puddle
[u]Roland[/u]
- Focus: Reduced damage to 500/700/1000
- Focus: Can now be deflected
[u]Zandora[/u]
- RMB-Conversion of Strength: All hits now reduce cooldown of other auras
- Q: Increased move speed buff 10% > 20%
- Q-All do haste: Increased move speed buff 25% > 40%
- Q-Conversion of Haste: All hits now reduce cooldown of other auras
- E: Increased purify range to match the aura
- E-Life goes on: Increased healing 35 > 40hp/s
- E-Conversion of Life: All hits now reduce cooldown of other auras
 
[b]Additional fixes[/b]
- Several improvements to bot pathfinding
- Fixed several crew panel and invite UI bugs (including wrong order in case of multiple crew invites)
- Fixed several UI and text issues and descriptions (including lore snippets for emotes)
- Fixed several spectator camera collision issues
- Fixed high-level players sometimes receiving incorrect rewards
- Fixed ending up in Clash queue after queueing for Ranked when another player declined the match
- Fixed a visual bug for Ranked where it sometimes looked like players lost MMR after a win
 
[b]Known Issues[/b]
- Region/server matchmaking issue
[i]DEV NOTE: We’ve made changes to help fix this issue. Some players may still experience being put on the wrong server. [/i]
- Improving solo queue wait times
[i]DEV NOTE: We’ve made changes to fix wait times and have seen improvements. [/i]
- Issues surrounding custom games
- In rare cases, Easy Anti-Cheat might have to be re-installed manually to play the game. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1924490/discussions/0/4521134679768748081/]Please check this thread for detailed steps.[/url]
- Cyclops may wander away from the power circle on Point C of Sanctum Falls
- A Cyclops wall doesn't disappear in certain situations when the Cyclops dies
- Kajir: Enemies may be revealed for longer if Kajir dies during his focus skill
- Beckett: Machine pistols sometimes don't work upon entering a match
- Roland: Grappling Hook goes into 2 second cooldown when deflected
- Wu + Pakko: A desync can occur when Pakko uses Snowball Toss right before getting hit by Wu's Tonguelash
- Mozu: Missing the door VFX when using Dimensional Door
- A defending hero's death sometimes adds shield for the Guardian
- Leaving a Ranked match after the "it's safe to leave" message sometimes still leads to penalty points

notes.title: Ranked Season One launches July 23
notes.content:
Hello Gigantic fans!

Our Ranked Pre-Season on PC has now concluded, which means the launch of Season One on all platforms is on the horizon. Starting [b]July 23[/b], jump off the airship in Ranked Mode for glory, ranks, and rewards. If you want to get a refresher on Ranked Mode in the meantime, [url=https://www.gogigantic.com/en/news-article/11569550]check out this article[/url]! Additionally, we’ll be introducing in-game weekend events for you to get free hero and weapon skins that were not in the original Gigantic! 

[h2]PRE-SEASON RECAP[/h2]
With details on what’s to come for Ranked and in-game events, let’s look back at the past four weeks of Pre-Season on PC. First off, a huge thank you to all of you who jumped into Gigantic: Rampage Edition to compete in our Ranked Mode Pre-Season. As we mentioned before, this was meant to be a warm-up for the real deal, allowing us to do some finetuning based on your reactions. We’re extremely grateful for all your feedback and suggestions during that time, they helped us squash some bugs and make adjustments that will improve your experience in Season One and beyond, such as queue time and matchmaking improvements.

[h2]SEASON ONE SNEAK PEEK[/h2]
Season One will last three months, during which you’ll try and climb the ranks as high as possible to earn exclusive profile portraits and titles. Throughout these three months, we’ll be running special weekend events for you to add new hero and weapon skins to your collection. Fancy a fresh new drip for Tyto? Make sure to be around when it’s time! We’ll have a complete overview of what Season One entails, and which rewards you can earn when and how, when it hits on July 23!

Once again, thank you all so much for your ongoing support. We’ll see you on the airship!

notes.title: June Dev Update
notes.content:
Gigantic players – Thanks so much for your continued support, and we really appreciate all the PC players who’ve been playing in the Pre-Season for Ranked Mode!

Before the end of the month, we wanted to give you all a couple of updates.

We’re planning to release another major patch early next month! Like our last major patch, this one will have a ton of fixes for bugs you all have brought up. We’re also looking into high priority issues that have been flagged, including the region server matchmaking issue where some players sometimes end up in the wrong server for their region causing them high ping, along with the solo queue wait time bug.

We kicked off the Pre-Season for Ranked on PC last week and the feedback and support we’ve gotten already has been incredibly valuable! As you all know, Pre-Season is a warm-up for Ranked to make sure things are working as intended and to hear from you on what could be improved before we kick off Season One across all platforms. Thanks to your feedback, we’ve been able to identify how we could improve Ranked across the board, including limiting the size of a crew who can queue for a Ranked match (e.g., removing 5 stacks). Please continue to share your feedback, so we can make a ton of improvements before we start Season One. 

As always, thanks for your support and feedback!

notes.title: Ranked Mode is coming to Gigantic: Rampage Edition!
notes.content:
Hello Gigantic fans!

We’re excited to reveal that Ranked Mode has arrived in [i]Gigantic: Rampage Edition[/i] and its Pre-Season is live right now on PC! This mode is especially for those of you who want to scratch their competitive itch, rise through the ranks, and earn unique rewards in the process. Read on for all the details about Ranked Mode and see what’s in store for pre-Season.
 
[h2][i]Gigantic: Rampage Edition[/i] Ranked Mode 101[/h2]

[h3]Ranked Mode in a nutshell[/h3]
All players that have reached profile level 20 can participate in Ranked matches, which use the traditional Clash game mode. In order to get your initial rank, five placement matches have to be played. Depending on the outcome of these matches, you’ll be awarded a Matchmaking Rating (MMR), which ultimately defines your global rank in the running Season. Wins and losses over the course of a Ranked Mode Season will affect your MMR and thus your rank. Your highest rank achieved throughout a season will define the rewards you will receive once the season ends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889987/633949d17812ff41dd8ba13d139f257384fc108c.jpg[/img]
[h3]Season System & Pre-Season[/h3]
Ranked Mode will come with a seasonal system, with each season running for approximately three months. You can follow your own progression, and that of your friends and foes, on a leaderboard. Reaching different ranks throughout the course of a season does not only give you bragging rights in the community, but it also comes with exclusive rewards for each season. Watch this space for details when these seasons draw closer!

We’re kicking off Ranked Mode today with a Pre-Season on PC – Ranked Mode on Xbox and PlayStation will be ready at a later date*. This is a much shorter version of the regular seasons, a warm-up if you will. We want to use this Pre-Season to make sure that everything works as intended and to get your feedback in case any concerns or issues come up. That being said, there is still a reward up for grabs: All players that reach Bronze rank and up in Pre-Season will gain the special in-game title “Vanguard”!

Keep an eye on our social channels and [url=https://discord.gg/GoGigantic]Discord[/url] for an announcement as we near the end of Pre-Season!

*Note: With Pre-Season and Ranked not available currently on consoles, if you try to join a Ranked match with a PC player, an error message will occur and the match will not begin. You'll be able to jump into matches once Pre-Season is available on consoles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889987/1f45ad568e20c3fde017623ae8122a9870985bbd.jpg[/img]
[h3]MMR and Ranks[/h3]
Your MMR, based on the TrueSkill System, is primarily calculated by winning and losing Ranked matches, adding to or deducting points from your overall score after each match. Your overall MMR defines your current rank as a season progresses. These ranks are:
[list]
[*] Bronze
[*] Silver
[*] Gold
[*] Platinum
[*] Diamond
[*] Guardian
[*] Gigantic Guardian
[/list]
While the Bronze, Silver, and Gold ranks each have five different tiers (e.g. “Silver IV”), Platinum will have three and the remaining only one. You will be notified when your next Ranked match is a promotion or demotion match. Do you have what it takes to reach Diamond rank and beyond?

If you do: Hell Yeah! But that also means you cannot rest on your laurels for too long. Starting with Diamond, your rank will decay if you haven’t played any Ranked matches for a certain time. When that happens, you will be put into the “Rank Decay” state where a number of placement matches will determine your rank again. With each match you play in Diamond and above, you can accumulate “Banked Days” (up to 30 in Diamond, up to 10 in Guardian) that will prevent you from falling into High Rank Placement State.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889987/430e1865e0a616c351a98764d4a00c1748e4937e.jpg[/img]
[h3]Matchmaking[/h3]
Like the regular Rush and Clash modes, matchmaking in Ranked will use MMR to create a balanced environment, prioritizing finding players of a similar rank. If necessary, the search parameters will be expanded, including a higher rank difference and expanding the matchmaking region.

You’ll be able to queue for Ranked matches both as solo players and in parties. Some matchmaking rules apply here:
[list]
[*] Matchmaking will try to match solo players with other solo players first.
[*] Matchmaking will try to match parties with other parties first.
[*] Parties can only queue for Ranked matches if their members are within six ranks of each other. The exception to this rule is a full party of five players.
[/list]
Please play Ranked matches with fair play in mind. If you leave a match before it ends, and you fail to re-connect within a certain time, a penalty will be given out. Accumulating penalty points will ultimately lead to a temporary ban from Ranked Mode. Penalty points do decline and reset for players if no penalties have been accumulated after a certain amount of time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889987/c748526e62b21daf333ae040197a7cc53ce52368.jpg[/img]
We cannot wait for you all to dip your feet in Ranked Mode matches as our Pre-Season kicks off right now. As always, we’d love to hear your feedback and suggestions over on [url=https://discord.gg/GoGigantic]Discord[/url], so that we can make it the best possible experience for everyone. Your support since launching [i]Gigantic: Rampage Edition[/i] has been invaluable, and we’d like to thank you for your ongoing loyalty. Good luck, have fun – and see you on the airship!

notes.title: Update Notes 6/7/2024
notes.content:
Build number: #614457.0

Hello Gigantic fans!

We’ve released another patch today that fixes multiple issues, which the team has been working on in the past few weeks. Check further below for the full patch notes.

As always, we’d like to thank you for your continued support, showing your love both by competing in the server and by sending us feedback and bug reports. We’re still working on further fixes, which we’re aiming to implement later this month. And as you know, Ranked Mode is still in the works, too, so be on the lookout for some news on that front soon!

With today’s update, you’ll also be able to don the classic Margrave and Griselma skins in your matches that we’ve promised you a while ago. Margrave’s “The Fallen (Classic)” and Griselma’s “The Summoner (Classic)” skins have been unlocked for free and are ready to be equipped, while both their other classic variants have also been added and can be unlocked with Crowns. Enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889987/1871b69a480a1a5be1e954e89e5fd7aeebc2a43f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889987/4301dc3a56606a940dd6f53d54cf6ee8f5a83ff8.jpg[/img]

[h3]--Fixes in Today’s Patch--[/h3]

[b]New Content[/b]
- Added classic skins for Margrave and Griselma
 
[b]General[/b]
- Fixed involuntary pinging when navigating using the D-pad in multiple menus
- Fixed that the upgrade UI Talent category couldn’t be accessed while using mouse and keyboard
- Fixed several collision issues on Picaro Bay, Siren's Strand, Heaven's Ward, Ember Grove, and Ghost
- Fixed infernal portals on Siren's Strand and Ghost Reef
- Fixed rush rewards given to the first selected hero, instead of the most played hero
- Added a Quit Match button for custom games
- Fixed Controller Vertical Sensitivity setting only allowing 1 and 10
- Fixed free cosmetics showing an incorrect cost on the unlock pop-up
- Fixed "New Match" requeue failing when a crew member is still in the match summary
- Fixed that not accepting a custom game kicked players back to the start screen
- Fixed several crashes
 
[b]Balance Changes[/b]
[u]Rush Mode:[/u] Jump pads back to the airship are disabled while in combat
[u]General:[/u]
- Increased summon time for baby creatures 3 > 5s (this is after the player finishes summoning, but before the creature can move, attack, etc.)
- Increased respawn time increase when another player dies 0s > 2s
[u]Kajir:[/u]
- Fixed dodge attack hitting twice
- LMB-Organ Pierce: fixed bleed to actually be 36 damage/s
- E: Cooldown 25 > 20
- E: Copy damage 40 > 35
- E-Boarding Crew: Copy damage 25 > 20
- E-Toxin Shock: damage 85 > 60
- E-Toxin Shock: max stacks 7 > 6
- Copies now walk and sprint when Kajir does so
[u]Roland:[/u]
- RMB-Burning Bolas: damage 120 > 80
- Focus: reduced damage to 600/800/1100
[u]T-MAT:[/u]
- RMB-Talent, no longer applies burn to AoE hits (still does so for direct hits)
[u]Wu:[/u]
- E-Talent (tongue tide): Changed to decrease Tongue's cooldown by 2s and increased focus gain during clash (while retaining the pull effect of Tongue).
- E-Talent (tongue tide): Fixed that the talent introduced bugs for certain upgrades
[u]Imani:[/u]
- F-Concentration, reduced focus gain boost 20% > 15%
- Q-Blast Radius, reduced focus gain 4.4% > 3.2%
- Q-Blast Radius, no longer applies burn to AoE hits (only the direct hit, while the base area damage remains)
[u]Margrave:[/u]
- F-Concentration, reduced focus gain boost 20% > 15%
[u]HK-206:[/u]
- LMB: Heavily reduced the recoil in both regular and fortified mode
[u]Voden:[/u]
- Q-Spore Imitation: poison spore arrow damage 75 > 150
- Q-Talent: fixed for all upgrades: now always fires 1 extra arrow, regardless of upgrades chosen
[u]Ramsay:[/u]
- E-Lasting Effects, Poison damage 25 > 35 per second
[u]Ezren Ghal:[/u]
- E: Fixed and now correctly interrupts on hit
[u]Oru:[/u]
- LMB+RMB: range 18m > 20m
 
[b]Hero Bug Fixes[/b]
[u]Rush Mode:[/u]
- Fixed the clash talent not being active on most rush maps
[u]Rutger:[/u]
- Fixed shield regenerating immediately while receiving any kind of healing
- Fixed Q's cooldown being too high when cancelled while Burrow is active
- Fixed Q-Salt of the Earth restoring more stamina than intended
- Fixed Q-Burrowed Time only extending the shield regain duration, while not increasing amount of shield restored
[u]Aisling:[/u]
- Fixed most instances of Cador teleporting underneath the map
- Fixed Focus skill teleporting Sir Cador to Aisling instead of the target area
[u]Voden:[/u]
- Fixed E-Recovery Time upgrade not working correctly
[u]The Margrave:[/u]
- Fixed E-talent not working with upgrades
[u]Zandora:[/u]
- Fixed Q-Rainbow Dash not putting pushed enemies in combat
 
[b]Additional fixes[/b]
- Many other (102) UI and text fixes
- Fixed pings on power circles appearing too high, and out of view
- Fixed players earning upgrade points incorrectly after rejoining a match
- Fixed Practice Arena Jump Pads not functioning for a few seconds when entering the arena
- Fixed Tripp's Stark Reality skin graphical issue
- Fixed rewards sometimes not appearing for levels above 100
- Updated several skill descriptions to better explain how the skill works
- Fixed several weird bot behaviours
- Fixed incorrect behaviour for a few fortunes from Tripp, Griselma, and Rutger
- Fixed several statistics showing incorrectly in the profile screen

notes.title: Hotfix Notes 5/8/2024
notes.content:
Build Number: #614009.0

Hello Gigantic fans,

First, we’d like to thank you all so much for your support and feedback since we launched Gigantic: Rampage Edition last month! With Rampage Edition, it’s been a passion project for all of us as we set out to bring back Gigantic for you all to jump in and have fun playing the game once again after so many years. We are incredibly grateful for the overwhelming support you all have given us, and it’s helped us pinpoint what you all love about Rampage Edition and what could be improved to make it the best experience possible.

Our team has made progress on improving Rampage Edition, such as improving server issues that players encountered at launch – but we’re continuing to work hard on fixing additional issues. Encountering bugs, glitches and crashes can be frustrating, and we take these issues very seriously.

We’ve released a hotfix patch today to address and fix several pressing issues, including crashes players have run into.

Coming up, we plan to release a major update that will fix known issues – such as the PS5 crashing issue we’re continuing to work on fixing, along with region matchmaking issues. Our top priority is improving Rampage Edition for all players, but once we feel it’s been improved across the board, we’ll be releasing a content update with Ranked Mode and classic hero skins for Margrave and Griselma. We can’t wait for you all to jump into Ranked Mode when it’s ready.

Thank you again for your support and understanding. We are determined to make Gigantic: Rampage Edition the best Gigantic experience possible for all players, and we will continue to refine and improve the game.

[h3]--Fixes in Today’s Patch--[/h3]
[b]General[/b]
- Fixed various crashes across platforms
- Fixed crossplay button appearing as always disabled
- Fixed match history not displaying match results correctly
- Fixed issue with friends’ stats not displaying correctly
- Multiple fortune description updates
- Multiple description updates for hero skills, skill upgrades, builds, and lore
- Fixed multiple localization text issues
- Correction of Status Effect icons for Imani
- Bot Backfilling - Bots spawned after a player leaves are invincible and do not belong to either team

[b]Heroes[/b]
- Wu: Typhoon's Fury - Skill functionality updated
-- Duration of the Armor and Damage buff is now correctly increased to 10 seconds if the enemy was hit with the skill.

[h3]--Known Issues We’re Looking Into--[/h3]
- PS5 Crash
-- PS5 System is non-responsive when closing application after being stuck on the VS transition screen
- Region matchmaking
- Improving solo queue wait times
- Hero balancing
- "Creating Crew" bug on Arc
-- Temporary Workaround: Switch Arc client language to English
- Issues surrounding Custom games

notes.title: State of the Game #1
notes.content:
Gigantic Players!

We want to extend our sincerest apologies for any inconvenience or frustration you may have experienced over the past week. We understand that many players have encountered issues, and we want to assure you that we've been working diligently to address them. Our team has been tirelessly making fixes to improve your gameplay experience and will continue to do so. We appreciate your patience and support as we strive to provide you with the best possible gaming experience. Thank you for being a part of our community, and we look forward to seeing you on the airship.

[b]Issues Already Addressed: [/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the requeue/unknown queue issue
[*] Fixed issue with reporting players impacting server load
[*] Prevented the frontend from crashing due to redis timeouts
[*] Additional improvements to server stability
[*] Deployed a new frontend fix, which aims to fix the double timeout issue for requeue and add additional logging to help us debug the timeout queue issue
[/list]
[b]Known Issues: [/b]
[list]
[*] Console Crashes
[list]
[*] PS5 System is non-responsive when closing application after being stuck on the VS transition screen
[/list]
[*] Random crashes on Xbox platform
[*] Matchmaking Timeouts / Declines
[*] Ghost Matchmaking Issue
[*] Hero Balance
[list]
[*] Roland 100% Buff 
[*] Kajir E Skill Cooldown
[/list]
[*] Bot Backfilling - Bots spawned after a Player leaves are invincible and do not belong to either team. 
[*] Various Localization issues 
[*] Arc Platform Issues
[list]
[*] Hangs on "creating crew" when launching the game on Arc through non-English regions.
[*] Temporary Workaround: Switch Arc client language to English
[/list]
[/list]We expect fixes for these and other issues to come soon in a future update. This list is by no means complete, but rather a selection of hot topics within the community. Please don’t hesitate to make us aware of any issues you are encountering in the bug-report section of [url=https://discord.gg/GoGigantic]our Discord[/url]!

Looking ahead, we still have Ranked Mode coming your way, which will be shipped with a later update. And starting today, we’ve activated Double XP in-game, so you’ll be levelling up much faster. This event will be live between Friday, April 19th at 7am PDT / 4pm CEST and Monday, April 22nd at 7am PDT / 4pm CEST.

notes.title: Compensation Package
notes.content:
Hello Gigantic fans,

Over the past week, we’ve been working on fixing the issues that you have reported. And while we’re not quite where we want to be just yet, it has been a pleasure seeing you all jump into the game competing in Rush and Clash mode. We will keep working hard on squashing any remaining bugs and server hiccups in the upcoming days and weeks!

In the meantime, we’ve deployed a special airship to bring you the compensation package that we’ve promised you. It includes:
[list]
[*] 5.000 Crowns
[*] Charnok’s “A Cult of Greed” hero and weapon skin
[*] Coming in a later game update: The classic hero skins for Margrave and Griselma
[/list]
Additionally, we’re preparing a [b]Double XP event[/b] for this upcoming weekend. Keep an eye on our social channels and [url=https://discord.gg/GoGigantic]on our Discord[/url] for the details when the time comes.

Thank you once again, we’ll see you on the airship!

notes.title: Gigantic: Rampage Edition - Launch Patch Notes
notes.content:
We’re incredibly excited to be launching Gigantic: Rampage Edition today and we can’t wait to jump into some matches with you all! You’ve submitted a lot of feedback and bug reports during our Closed Beta back in February, thank you very much for your continued support and dedication. Below is a list of fixes and changes we’ve made since then, and we’re not done there: We invite you all to report any bugs you encounter and send in any feedback you have [url=https://discord.gg/GoGigantic]over on our Discord[/url]. We’ll see you on the airship!

[h3]-- Known Issues --[/h3]
- Custom matches: Currently, there is no option to manually quit out of custom matches. While we’re working on a solution, please quit by closing the game application.
​- In some cases, players might still encounter "waiting for unknown match" while queueing. Please leave the queue and re-queue when this happens.

[h3]-- Bug Fixes --[/h3]
- Fixed UI resetting during hero select when an ally locks in their hero.
- Fixed a way too lenient dodge input leading to lots of unintentional dodges.
- Fixed T-Mat's fire cracker upgrade applying cracked armor on non-burning targets.
- Fixed Aisling summoning Sir Cador underground.
- Fixed Oru's hat visually being pulled into the sky.
- Added back the green arrow on Uncle Sven's and Voden's jump boost areas.
- Fixed Margrave's leap jumping weirdly high.
- Fixed Tripp teleporting far away when using her focus skill on Grenn's weak spot.
- and many more…

[h3]-- Balancing --[/h3]
[u]General:[/u]
- Jump attacks: Reduced stamina cost: 25 > 15

[u]Beckett:[/u]
- Skill 2 - Smart Grenade: Removed push
- Skill 2 - Tear Gas: Added Cancel on direct hit
- Skill 2 - Lingering Fumes: Dazes 1 sec on direct hit

[u]Imani:[/u]
- Skill 2 - Slightly reduced damage fall-off distance
- Skill 2 - Combat Sniper: Reduced attack speed bonus: 20% > 10%
- Skill 3 - Reduced daze duration: 1 > 0.5 sec
- Skill 3 - Talent: Reduced damage reduction: 50% > 30%

[u]HK-206:[/u]
- Skill 3 - Cooldown: 12 sec > 13 sec

[u]Wu:[/u]
- Skill 3 - Talent: Now changes pull into 1 sec Daze (instead of extending the range)

[u]Zandora:[/u]
- Skill 2 & 3 & 4: Increased aura range 5m > 7m
- Skill 2 & 3 & 4: Increased aura duration 3s > 4s
- Increased focus gain by 20%

[u]Tyto the Swift:[/u]
- Focus: Added cancel on hit

[u]Tripp:[/u]
- Skill 3 - Added cancel on hit

[u]Xenobia:[/u]
- Skill 3 - Added cancel on hit

[u]T-MAT:[/u]
- Skill 1 - Increased damage fall-off (max distance 50m > 40m, damage at max distance 50% > 25%)
- Skill 1 - Fire Cracker: Reduced cracked armor duration: 2s > 1s
- Skill 2 - Slightly reduced homing of missiles (making it a bit easier to avoid them)
- Skill 3 - Booster Pack: Reduced move speed buff: 15% > 10%
- Skill 3 - Defense Boost: Reduced armor buff: 10 > 5
- Focus: Reduced damage by ~20%

notes.title: Announcing Gigantic: Rampage Edition
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=E9J98V8B63U;full][/previewyoutube]

We're thrilled to unveil Gigantic: Rampage Edition, the definitive release of the beloved MOBA hero shooter, Gigantic, created by Motiga. Developed by Abstraction Games, this premium edition promises both veteran players and newcomers an exhilarating journey into the world of team-based multiplayer gaming.

Set to launch on April 9, 2024, across PC, PlayStation, and Xbox platforms for $19.99, Gigantic: Rampage Edition amplifies the original game's thrills with dynamic gameplay, a diverse hero roster, and exciting new features. With zero microtransactions, players can unlock all content through gameplay or in-game currency.

[h3]What's in store:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Enhanced Gameplay[/b]: Dive into thrilling team battles with upgraded maps, new heroes like Roland and Kajir, and a Rush Mode for fast-paced action.
[*] [b]Customization[/b]: Tailor your hero with unique loadouts, skins, and progression options, making each gameplay experience truly your own.
[*] [b]Cross-Platform Play[/b]: Join friends across consoles and PC for epic multiplayer matches, breaking down platform barriers.
[*] [b]Post-Launch Support[/b]: Enjoy free updates, including Ranked Mode and new hero skins, ensuring continuous excitement and engagement.
[/list]
[h3]Closed Beta Testing:[/h3]
 
Get a taste of Gigantic: Rampage Edition's Rush Mode in a Closed Beta Test on Steam, starting February 22 at 12:00pm PST / 9pm CET. Sign up on the game's Steam page for a chance to join the action-packed playtest.

Gear up for Gigantic: Rampage Edition - the ultimate MOBA hero shooter adventure awaits!

Stay tuned for more updates and announcements and [url=https://discord.gg/kHsj3UcerH]join the discussion on our Gigantic Discord[/url]!
